capabilities: insert nested tabs, grids, and combined sections inside notes
snapshot per-block version history with labels, restores, and HEAD resets
diff versions inline, split, or patch across blocks, tabs, and cells
edit Markdown, callouts, and code blocks in structured in-place editors
script blocks and version operations via a CLI and file bridge
extras: Docs reference separate ARCHITECTURE.md, PRD.md, and DESIGN.md files. README warns of a 0.3.0 storage-format change: old note-local .mica folders are not auto-imported and users should back up before upgrading; works offline except for optional icon-pack downloads, and gives Obsidian Sync compatibility instructions.
intentEvidence: a modern replacement for the obsidian-tabs plugin
motivation: To fix obsidian-tabs, where editing a rendered tab could corrupt the note; Mica derives state from the live document instead of cached offsets.
problem: Obsidian has no way to nest tabs and grids inside a note and no per-block version history or diffing for the content inside them.

relations.evidence: Mica is a modern replacement for the obsidian-tabs plugin

summary: Structured content blocks for notes: nested tabs and grids in plain Markdown with per-block version history, diffing, and a companion CLI.
